name: 签名 recipe 包注册→active 下发→设备安装（正）

request.body: {apiVersion: cloudctl.recipe/v1, kind: LocalRecipePackage, manifest:{id,version,hash,signingKeyId:<已配置key>,minEngineVersion:1,platform:xiaohongshu,app:com.xingin.xhs,commandTypes:[xiaohongshu.publish_note.v1]}, graph:{...open-only checkpoint...}, signature:{algorithm:Ed25519,keyId,digest:<真签名>}}

steps.device: RecipePackageManager.verify: manifest.hash == sha256(canonical) == expected.sha256 三方一致 → 原子安装

notes: digest 不得为 hash-pinned-builtin（服务端 2472 拒收）；同名同版本不同 hash → 409
